== Decipher volunteer and playtester role (27 October 2026) ==

'''Build notes'''
* Decipher section and the 1998–2001 Service dates come from the Decipher Inc. entry of his LinkedIn Experience list (signed-in view, read 27 October 2026). The Preserved copy is an excerpt of that one entry with the screenshot [[:File:Mark Schaffer Decipher volunteer summary.png|File:Mark Schaffer LinkedIn Decipher experience.png]]; other jobs on the list are left out.
* [[People/S]] row: years 1998–2001 added.

'''Parked'''
* Parked, not a live issue (Bill, 27 October 2026: people move around; Squadron location discrepancies will be handled later). [[SWCCG regions]] lists Gold 41 Mark Schaffer under Tatooine, whose states there are New Mexico, Arizona, Colorado, Utah and Nevada, while his Decipher Squadrons profile gives region Tatooine and hometown Hampton, Va. Left as the sources give it.

'''Missing data'''
* No set page, rulebook credit or playtester list on the wiki names him; his playtesting rests on LinkedIn alone. The Decipher Squadrons profile gives no start year for his Gold 41 slot.

== "FL" answered (13 November 2026) ==
"FL" on Squadron slots means '''Flight Leader''': a key volunteer who worked more directly with Decipher ("basically a volunteer that helped decipher coordinate events", Ming Huo; "key volunteers that would be more involved directly with decipher", Scott Lingrell; Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, 9 October 2026). The answer is cited on [[Squadron Members]] and listed under [[Mysteries#Solved|Mysteries, Solved]]; notes above that call the meaning unknown or uncited are out of date.
